thread:
maria: Heads up — after the NV driver update to 560.11 on the h100 fleet we're seeing a latency regression on short-sequence workloads (~seq_len 32-128). p95 tokens up ~22%, p99 up ~18%. Autotuner flipped kernel prefs.

maria: Profiler snapshot (shortened):
```
kernel_choice_counts: { kern_attn_vec_v2: 412k, kern_attn_fused: 78k, kern_attn_smallpath: 18k }
avg_latency_ms: { kern_attn_vec_v2: 0.92, kern_attn_fused: 0.57, kern_attn_smallpath: 0.65 }
p99_token_ms: 1.8 -> 2.2 (post-upgrade)
```
(we used the same model binary, no code changes, just driver bump)

jon: Do we have kernel selection logs (`KERNEL_DECIDER` telemetry)? Any recent autotune table changes?

maria: KERNEL_DECIDER logs show a higher score for vec_v2 for short sequences after driver. No autotune policy changes — the autotuner run finished before the deploy. Looks like driver changed perf characteristics so the selector scoring flipped.

sophie: I pulled nvprof traces for a representative request. Short seq shows more warp divergence and mem latency for vec_v2 under 560.11. Flamegraph: vec_v2 hot in attention inner loop.

sophie: nvprof snippet:
```
Time(%)  Calls  Avg(ms)  Name
30.4     12345  0.85     kern_attn_vec_v2
18.2     4321   0.53     kern_attn_fused
```

dave: For immediate mitigation we can pin kernel picks at runtime. Example runtime override (canary):
```json
{
  "autotune": { "enabled": true },
  "kernel_selector": { "force_short_seq": "kern_attn_fused", "force_long_seq": null }
}
```
We can push the override to 2% traffic and watch p99.

ryan: Dedicated canaries already spiked CPU queueing on some nodes when vec_v2 became dominant. Rolling back driver on large fleets is heavy — prefer runtime mitigation if it buys time.

ops-bot: Driver upgrade job `driver-upgrade/560.11` completed on 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z for pool h100-prod (72 hosts). No automated rollback scheduled.

maria: I'll prepare a canary runtime with the kernel pin and update the rollout policy to 2% -> 20% over 30m if metrics stable. Also adding a metric: `kernel_choice.vec_v2_rate` to alert if >10% for short-seq clients.

jon: Good. Also add a quick query to check historical selector votes so we can revert autotune if needed:
`SELECT time, selector_score FROM kernel_votes WHERE kernel="kern_attn_vec_v2" AND seq_len<128`

sophie: I'll write a short ops runbook for rollback and hotpatching the kernel selector:
```
/ops runbook kernel-decider-rollback
1) Deploy runtime override (dave's JSON) to 2% canary
2) Monitor p95/p99, kv-cache miss latency, and GPU SM utilization for 30m
3) If p99 down >10% and no error spike, ramp to 20% in 15m
4) If errors or cost regressions, revert override and open emergency rollback ticket to infra for driver downgrade
```

dave: Also adding a temporary telemetry hook that tags requests by chosen kernel so we can backfill counts quickly.

ryan: I'll open the infra ticket for a possible driver rollback plan but we won't execute without product/ops agreement. Need approval due to maintenance window impact.

maria: Thanks — prioritizing the canary push now. I'll post results in this thread. :eyes:

jon: Thanks team. If the runtime fix holds we should trigger an autotune re-run under the new driver in staging and update the autotuner scoring to prefer the slower-but-stable path for prod until we get a driver fix.
